repos_data.description: Run Linux desktops and apps on macOS with a native Metal Wayland compositor, Apple Container GUI, Waypipe, Docker/OrbStack, and rootless windows.
Visually explore all running tasks (processes) ....viewing its signature status, loaded dylibs, open files, network connection, and much more.

repo_meta_data.description: Mac app that shows all open files, directories, sockets, pipes and devices in use by all running processes. Nice GUI for lsof.
